chapter: Tulane Brass Band and bass drum
title: Ernest Rebennack teaches Happy bass drum in the Tuxedo band
summary: Happy tells how Ernest, a reader, urged him to learn bass drum and how he later brought Little Jim into the Tuxedo band; Jim was close friends with Black Benny.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught
